blocks.html: Exit openings from tents shall remain open unless covered by a flame-resistant curtain of a contrasting color to the tent. Such curtain shall be supported not less than 80 inches (2032 mm) above the floor level at the exit and, when open, no part of the curtain shall obstruct the exit.
